d: Identify, generate and analyse BD projects internal and external to Sohar Aluminium (SA) that the company could pursue to improve business sustainability and/or deliver significant improvements to business performance, operational excellence, health, safety or environmental performance including decarbonization.
Prepare Business Case (BC) proposals on selected Growth Projects (GPs) for approval by the relevant governance bodies.
Optimise, derisk and implement approved projects and/or organise the efficient hand over of these projects to other resources to implement.
Lead selected projects at Order of Magnitude (OoM), Pre-Feasibility (PFS) and/or Feasibility (FS) Levels
Support the BD&SE and/or Shareholders in identification and evaluation of opportunities to supply electrical energy to Sohar Aluminium (SA) for ongoing operations and for significant GPs
q: •Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical / Chemical / Industrial / Metallurgy) plus 10 years of relevant progressive working experience within the industrial sector (e.g. mining, minerals, metals or manufacturing industry)
Familiarity with various Best Practice Aluminium smelting technology and processes
•Proven track record of similar BD activities in the Aluminium smelting industry
•Experience working in GCC region or multiple regions
r: 3.1 Identify and manage the main enablers for the BDM Role

•Review and understand the SA Growth Project Approval Procedure (SA GP Approval Procedure) and the general site Capital Project Management and Approval Procedure including the interaction and application of each.
•The role requires generation of ideas that could be implemented at SA to improve business sustainability. Including:
•Improving “Cash Flow From Operations”, via a combination of growth in saleable tonnes, achievement of higher netbacks or improving capital or operating costs, and/or
•Delivering significant improvements to health, safety or environmental performance including decarbonization.
•To achieve this, the BDM is expected to
•Develop strong relationships with SA Exco, Managers, Business Review Committee (BRC) Members and relevant individuals with areas of specialist expertise,

•Maintain active monitoring outside of SA to identify existing practices at other aluminium companies and potential developments outside the aluminium sector that may potentially be implemented at SA, and
•Work with individuals, governments, shareholders, vendors, other aluminium companies, external companies and institutions to identify potential development projects.
Monitor and track each Shareholder’s Major Projects Approval process and periodically review and recommend improvements to the SA GP Approval Procedure to the BD&SE

Ensure appropriate documentation of all potential developments investigated, so that the information and analysis can be easily accessed and understood in the future if there is a decision to revisit a potential development.
Collate and perform initial screening of potential projects.

Generate short lists of potential projects for further analysis, determine the applicable development path (i.e. Site Department Sponsored under General site Capital Project Management and Approval Procedure, or BD&S Sponsored under SA GP Approval Procedure).
Manage efficient and effective hand-over of Site Department Sponsored projects to the respective department as approved by the BD&SE

Perform initial analysis of remaining short-listed projects to determine if there is merit in further resourcing the potential project and prepare scenarios agreed with the BD&SE for consideration for funding under the Growth Projects (GP) SGR(-1) approval process.

Prepare Business Case (BC) and other documentation for the SGR(-1) approval process, including clear articulation of the likely additional activities outside of the traditional scope of an Engineering Services provider that will be required or is highly desirable for the project to proceed and deliver optimum value (i.e. the “Enablers”).
3.3 Lead Concept Studies and prepare BC proposals on SGR(-1) approved GPs

Manage Concept Stage development for GPs approved at SGR-1 and prepare them for consideration to submit for SGR0 Approval, with the aim to secure allocation of funding for an Order of Magnitude Study (OoM).
Conduct work required under the SA GP Approval Procedure to prepare and present the business case and other documentation for the SGR0 approval process:
Conduct day-to-day activities on the work

Identify and engage with key stakeholders, internal and external to the site, to quickly assess the viability of the project based on the key internal and external issues and to determine the required project enablers
Schedule project activities including milestones for project activities and project enablers
Address issues identified in the study that may impact the resolution of the project enablers and/or the successful delivery of the project against the schedule
Provide regular appropriate progress to the BD&SE
Provide recommendation to BD&SE on modifications to scope to reshape the project to optimise probability of success and/or potential improvement of outcomes
Prepare the documents for the SGR0 meeting.
Provide recommendation to BD&SE to redefine, place on hold, terminate or proceed with an approval request at SGR0 for the project.
3.4 Optimize, Derisk and Prepare Business Case for GPs to enter SGR1, SGR2 & SGR3
•Lead activities to optimise and derisk GPs approved at SGR0, SGR1 & SGR2
•Recommend the appropriate department to be accountable for progressing and reporting on each of the optimization and derisking activities.
•Lead the preparation and presentation of the business case for Growth Projects at SGR1, SGR2 and SGR3.
•Provide recommendation to BD&SE to redefine, place on hold, terminate or procced with an approval request at the respective SGR.
3.5Lead selected projects at OoM, PFS and/or FS Levels
•Subject to appointment by the BD&SE, manage specific GPs at OoM, PFS and/or FS Levels in accordance with the SA GP Approval Procedure.

•Identify and engage with key site stakeholders, internal and external to the site, to quickly assess the viability of the project based on the key internal and external issues and to determine the required project enablers
•Schedule project activities including milestones for project activities and the project enablers
•Address issues identified in the study that may impact the resolution of the project enablers and/or the successful delivery of the project against the schedule
•Provide regular appropriate progress to the BD&SE
•Provide recommendation to BD&SE on modifications to scope to reshape the project to optimize probability of success and/or potential improvement of outcomes
3.6 Support identification and evaluation of electrical energy supply options to SA
•Support the BD&SE and/or the Shareholders to identify and evaluate various options for the supply of electricity to SA.
•Recognising the need to secure long term, competitive, firm electricity supply for:
•Potline 1 beyond the expiration of the exiting gas contract
3.7 Perform Other Tasks as assigned by your manager
•Perform additional tasks as assigned by your manager
•Act as deputy for BD&SE as assigned
3.8 Action the SA Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) procedures to Maintain EHS standards.
•Actions the SA EHS safety routines for his/her work area.
•Actions regular inspections to ensure safety. Raise improvement CAPA actions.
•Maintains SA housekeeping standards (5S) in his/her work area.
•Devise creative ways to motivate people to work safely and to embrace EHS.
•Engage the team around safety to develop new safety leaders.
